business_problem: give investment clients timely, complete data across the front, middle, and back office without the performance, replication, and sharing limits of older architectures.
solution_summary: State Street uses Snowflake and Secure Data Sharing to power its Alpha Data Platform, a front-to-back investment data service that unifies portfolio and operational insight across the investment lifecycle. Investment, cash, collateral, securities-lending, counterparty, and risk datasets are collected, curated, validated, and shared through Snowflake so asset managers can work from a timely enterprise view instead of piecing together siloed systems and copied extracts. Secure Data Sharing lets State Street exchange live data and onboard vendor datasets into client environments in minutes rather than months, while native AI and machine-learning capabilities support deep-learning-based data quality and anomaly detection inside the same governed platform. The result is near-real-time investment visibility, faster client onboarding, lower labor costs, and more efficient exception handling for operations teams using State Street Alpha.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the core Alpha Data Platform where investment and operational data is collected, curated, validated, and analyzed.

solution_components.name: Secure Data Sharing
solution_components.role: Moves live vendor and client datasets into customer environments without replicated batch extracts.

data_flow: Investment and operational datasets are collected into Snowflake, where they are curated, validated, and analyzed for Alpha Data Platform workflows. Secure Data Sharing then distributes live vendor and client data into customer environments, and AI-assisted data-quality outputs help operations teams resolve true exceptions faster.
business_outcome: State Street achieved 25x productivity gains in anomaly investigation, cut total labor costs by 50%, and accelerated delivery of live investment data and insights to Alpha clients.
metrics: 50% Lower total cost of labor (TCL) with Snowflake
architecture_clues: Snowflake runs on Azure as the data backbone for State Street Alpha.
Secure Data Sharing replaces replicated ETL-style data delivery with live exchange into client environments.
Deep-learning models inside the platform focus on data quality and anomaly detection for portfolio operations.
evidence_quotes: With Snowflake, we put data in our clients’ hands much faster — and with half the effort and resources
